topic: Investigating suspicious traffic spikes in airport data
summary_markdown: Someone noted a suspicious pattern in the airport analytics: since 2025-04-25, unique users and footfalls have been increasing sharply (by about 1.5 times), while total traffic remains stable. This discrepancy suggests an anomaly that needs investigation. The concern is whether this spike might be due to data cleaning or deduplication processes performed on the previous day.
action_items: Review the specific analytics link provided by [p1] to investigate the unique user and footfall spikes.
